prompt: Validate a supplied Episode Journal with missing audit references and require targeted recovery to repair the audit refs from supplied artifacts.

initial_state.task_intent: Detect an audit gap in supplied journal metadata and repair evidence and verifier references.

input_artifacts.description: Episode Journal missing evidence and verifier refs.
Evidence and verifier artifacts that can repair the missing refs.

success_criteria: The audit validator detects missing evidence and verifier refs.
The runtime rejects the incomplete journal as an audit gap.
Targeted Recovery writes a repaired audit record with refs restored.
The repaired audit record passes the audit checklist.
failure_criteria: The incomplete journal is treated as audit-complete.
The missing refs are ignored in recovery.
Recovery fabricates refs that are absent from supplied artifacts.
